title: A shipped-course override (DEV-538)
description: HAND-AUTHORED. A patch over one generated mission in content/levels/, keyed by 2016's own fileIDs, applied by loadLevel (src/content/load-level.ts). The authority is validateOverride in src/content/level-override.ts; this file describes it for an editor and is held to its closed field list by tests/unit/level-overrides.test.ts. Positions are THREE space, world, like every number in content/levels/. Plan: docs/plan/SHIPPED-COURSE-EDITS.md.

quat.description: xyzw, three.js order; stored normalised, w >= 0, to 1e-6.

entities.description: Move, remove or add entities of one kind. A move is RIGID (a ring's trigger keeps its offset and turn); an add is the mission's first live one, moved.

move.description: fileID -> { pos, quat }. Keys and poses are checked by validateOverride; this subset of JSON Schema has no keyword for them.

mission.description: The generated mission id; the file is content/overrides/<mission>.json.

base.description: sha256 of content/levels/<mission>.json as content/_generated.sha256 lists it. A re-extraction that moves it turns level-overrides.test.ts red.

finish.description: The finish trigger's new pose; frame and studs move with it. A sphere-union gate only.

points.description: The racing line's control points (the player course's bounds); resampled on load.

medals.description: Optional. Absent, the medals re-derive from the ring count (playerCourseMedals).
